_doc: shift-test padding (docs/shiftable.md). ram: SEG -> {text|data|bss: [[before_unit, bytes]]} (unit ordinals count within that section; text/data pads are assembled objects: a dummy function / a data object, bss pads are space). rom: pads [[before_rom_offset, bytes]], add [{before, name, size}] (a new file), drop [rom_offset] (units nothing refers to: here the 11 zero bytes between the last building model and the static segment). The texture-area pad (0x2D9750) follows a texture the test run never loads: a texture's DMA length is the distance to the next table entry, so bytes inserted after a texture are read and decoded as part of it.
